_read_me: 入口红点读数的唯一事实源。红点必须绑定到一个入口或一条任务行；任何没有在这张表里登记过的入口，其红点不得被读成 PRESENT 或 ABSENT。每条记录都写明它是被量过的还是只是声明。PRESENT / ABSENT / UNKNOWN 三态：入口不在当前页面、或它在页面上但被滚动或遮挡而看不到时，一律 UNKNOWN，绝不可记成 ABSENT（操作者 §一、§五）。
measured_on: 2026-09-23, over frames whose own episode record says page=HOME with the 快捷面板 closed
red_pixel_rule: r >= 150 and r-g >= 50 and r-b >= 50, connected blob >= 40 px (the family the 快捷面板 row reader already uses)

entries.label: 邮件
entries.anchor: the entry icon's own top-right corner
entries.behaviour: present in 9 of 26 sampled city frames, absent in 17 -- it comes and goes
evidence_frames: a city frame at 16:02:29 whose entry draws a red circle with the count 5
a city frame at 16:20:06 whose entry draws no badge at all
entries.verification: the badge is a red circle with a white count; it is the only red blob inside the search window in every sampled frame that has one, and there is no blob at all in the frames where the client draws none

entries.label: 探险页签
entries.anchor: the bottom-bar tab's own top-right corner
entries.behaviour: present in 9 of 26 sampled city frames; the geometry is identical whenever it is present
evidence_frames: a city frame at 16:05:26 with the dot drawn
a city frame at 16:02:29 with none
entries.verification: 197 px in every frame that has it, in the same 21x15 px box.  The first pass reported red in 10 of 14 frames here and was wrong twice over: its window (x 0.092-0.252) reached into the 英雄 tab, so a neighbour's dot was attributed to 探险

entries.label: 章节/每日任务入口
entries.anchor: the entry icon's own top-right corner
entries.behaviour: present in 26 of 26 sampled frames -- a count badge that never read zero in this sample
evidence_frames: a city frame at 16:02:29 whose badge reads 2
a city frame at 16:05:26 whose badge reads 4
entries.verification: the pixel count follows the digits (278-284) while the circle stays fixed, so this is a count badge rather than artwork.  NOT usable as a trigger yet: no sampled frame shows it absent, so ABSENT cannot be distinguished from 'the sample never caught it empty'

evidence_frames: a city frame at 16:02:29 whose badge reads 26

entries.label: 英雄页签

entries.behaviour: present in 26 of 26 sampled frames with identical geometry AND identical size
entries.verification: a notification has to be able to go away, and this one never varied across three hours, so a permanent badge and a fixed red element inside the button's artwork cannot be told apart with this sample.  Do not read it as PRESENT or ABSENT until a frame with an empty hero tab is available

not_measured: RED_DOT_TASK, RED_DOT_EVENT, RED_DOT_REWARD, RED_DOT_BUILDING, RED_DOT_RESEARCH: the dictionary declares them and no window has been measured for any of them. They are UNBOUND and must not be read.
快捷面板的行角标由 read_quick_panel 的行读数给出（rows[].badge）；面板关闭时那些行是 UNKNOWN 而不是 ABSENT，这一点已由面板读取器实现，不重复登记在这里。
邮件页签角标与联盟赠礼角标由邮件页与联盟页的读取器给出（mail.tab_badges / alliance.badge_count）。
_dot_variability_read_me: 红点能不能当优先级信号，取决于它会不会消失：只有被观察到既有 PRESENT 又有 ABSENT 的角标才算信号（winter_agent_v2.entry_badges.dot_varies）。一个一直是 PRESENT 的角标是常量或图案，拿它排序等于用常量排序；只见过 ABSENT 的角标不会触发，但也还没被证明是信号。本节数字由 tools/measure_mail_dot_blind_window.py 与 tools/measure_panel_row_badges.py 从 learning/episodes.jsonl 复算，改动前请先复算。
